## Neurostimulation For Everyone

Discover our latest innovation - FeelZing Energy Patch

[Discover Feelzing](https://www.feelzing.com/)

## 5 Questions, 5 Answers About Thync

## 1. What does Thync do?

We build devices usable by everyone that improve brain function via electricity, the natural language of the brain.

We were founded in 2010, and have since researched and developed how to democratize access to the benefits of neurostimulation for everyone.

## 2. How does Thync improve brain function with electricity?

For 10+ years, we've developed and tested various non-invasive neurostimulation devices, including headsets and patches.

These wearable devices send electric stimulation programs we've designed to specific areas of the brain and peripheral nervous system we've selected to instigate the desired positive effect.

## 3. Why do you believe that non-invasive brain stimulation works?

Two reasons: 1) we cross-referenced our work with the broader literature from the greater scientific community, and 2) we've tested various iterations of our products for over ten years, not just in research labs, but with reputable partner institutions, influential minds, and, of course, on ourselves.

## 4. How are you validating your technology?

Our product research team constantly runs trials to test the different effects of electric stimulation on health, behavior, and physiology.

Thync has also partnered with academic labs and organizations around the world to test our products with unique populations, including athletes, gamers, military, and surgeons.

## 5. How can I try Thync’s technology?

Please visit our website [feelzing.com](http://feelzing.com) to learn about a wearable patch that increases energy, clarity, and alertness for a few hours — think 5-hour energy, neurostimulation style.

#### Our Approach To Science

Hear from our Thync's lead scientist, Dr. Jonathan Charlesworth, how we developed our technology to be effective and safe.

  Play [video_title] video

## Highlighted Scientific Papers

Thync neurostimulation significantly reduces behavioral and physiological tension, anxiety, and stress.

 [Read MORE](https://thync.com/pages/neurostimulation#nature)

Thync neurostimulation prior to sleep produces significant improvements in sleep quality and mood.

 [READ MORE](https://thync.com/pages/neurostimulation#biorxiv)

Safety of Thync stimulation was demonstrated in over two thousand sessions over six weeks.

 [Read more](https://thync.com/pages/neurostimulation#peerj)

I built the site as a single static page, `index.html`, in the project folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and the logo strip are unchecked.

It has a hero section, the five Q&As, an "Our Approach To Science" video section, the three paper cards, the "Featured In" logos, and a footer. It's responsive and uses no external dependencies. It reads the images from `images/`, so keep that folder next to the file.

- **E-trust badge:** Its footer image is shown on a white chip so it stays visible.
- **Shopify link:** I left out the "Powered by Shopify" link from the footer.
